svg.title: Tabs
svg.desc: Each tab is a WKWebView in a borderless, transparent, click-through window placed far off screen, at (-30000, -30000). WebKit's occlusion detection is turned off for these windows. As a result the page reports document.visibilityState == "visible", runs requestAnimationFrame at about 30 frames a second, and fires IntersectionObserver. A web view that isn't in a window at all reports itself hidden and stalls its animation frames, which breaks lazy loading and infinite scroll. A tab left unused for 5 minutes is hidden on purpose, so it slows down as a background tab does, and shown again before the next command on it runs (see the daemon above).
